nodes.plm_caption:
This video shows someone recording a cooking tutorial. You see a woman put together the ingredients for muffins and pan them before showing a photograph of her.
The video begins with a logo in red, white and black for " Kara Corey Fit Life & Training". You see a woman beginning to talk in a white t-shirt and necklace with dark brown cabinets behind her, with two plastic drink containers, a bowl of bananas and flowers to her left. She continues talking and shows the ingredients for muffins. You see her put some flour in a glass bowl, followed by more ingredients and mixing them all together before filling the muffin tins and baking. You then see a picture of what the muffins look like cooked with white crumbles on top. The woman then holds up two more ingredients, showing them to the camera, before starting to talk again.
The video ends with a close-up shot of a young woman posing against a barn door while on the left are two screens, the first of which shows a small square frame with a woman in a sports bra and shorts, and the other shows social media handles for Kara Corey Fit Life.
The video is shown in fast-motion, with bright and even lighting.

summary.brief: Kara Corey mixes a protein‑rich apple‑pie filling, portions it into a muffin tin, chills the mini pies, and then shows the finished treats before a fitness‑brand promotional close‑up.
summary.detailed: The video opens with the red‑white‑black “Kara Corey Fit Life & Training” logo, then cuts to Kara in a bright kitchen with dark cabinets, a coffee maker, bananas and a vase of flowers on the counter. She introduces a no‑bake mini apple‑pie recipe and adds 1½ scoops of Apple Pie MTS mix, oat flour, almond flour, pumpkin‑pie spice and pink sea salt to a clear mixing bowl. She folds in unsweetened applesauce, diced apple, lemon juice, sugar‑free maple syrup and a spoonful of peanut butter, stirring until the batter is smooth. She sprays a six‑cup muffin tin with non‑stick cooking spray, spoons the mixture into each cup, flattens the tops with the bottom of a measuring cup, and sprinkles a little quick oats and Splenda brown‑sugar on each. The pan is placed in the refrigerator to chill for about an hour. After chilling she removes the mini pies, notes they are still a bit sticky but tasty, and suggests they can be eaten right away, chilled longer, or frozen. She holds a plate of the finished pies, describes their cinnamon‑apple flavor and the protein boost from the MTS mix, and briefly shows a container of MTS protein powder with an apple‑pie scent. The segment ends with a close‑up of Kara posing against a barn door while two side screens display a small inset of a woman in a sports bra and the Kara Corey Fit Life social‑media handles, all presented in fast‑motion with bright, even lighting.

action.detailed: Combine the Apple Pie MTS mix, oat flour, almond flour, pumpkin‑pie spice, pink sea salt, unsweetened applesauce, diced apple, lemon juice, sugar‑free maple syrup and peanut butter in a bowl, stir until smooth, spray a six‑cup muffin tin, spoon the mixture into each cup, flatten the tops, sprinkle quick oats and Splenda brown‑sugar, chill the pan for about an hour, then remove and serve the mini pies.
action.actor: Kara Corey, the fitness influencer hosting the cooking tutorial

nodes.plm_caption:
The video features an introduction sequence with an "anti-bullying" logo at the beginning. After that, a fit and confident woman presents an exercise routine video that demonstrates how to make a type of muffin with flour, other ingredients and a panning shot of muffin cups on the end.
For the video, you need four ingredients (a liquid ingredient and three dry ingredients), 1 cup diced fruit, 1 tablespoon melted butter, and half cup brown sugar. Use 1 teaspoon of cinnamon and 1 teaspoon of ginger. For the muffin cases use a muffing pan with six rows. Mix with a few fingertips of coconut oil at the end.
For this video, show the muffin pan lined with a muffin cup, spooning of the mixture, and a sprinkle of coconut oil.

summary.brief: Kara Corey mixes a no‑bake apple‑pie batter, fills a sprayed muffin tin, adds a light topping, and chills the mini apple pies.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with a logo animation and a brief intro, then Kara Corey appears in a kitchen wearing a white T‑shirt. She adds 1½ scoops of MTS Apple Pie mix, ½ cup oat flour, ¼ cup almond flour, a sprinkle of pumpkin‑pie spice, a pinch of pink sea salt, 4 oz unsweetened applesauce (about 40 g diced apple), 1 Tbsp lemon juice, 2 Tbsp sugar‑free maple syrup, and 2 Tbsp peanut butter into a bowl and mixes until smooth. She sprays a black muffin tin with non‑stick cooking spray, spoons the batter evenly into six muffin cups, flattens the tops with the bottom of a measuring cup, and optionally sprinkles a little quick oats and Splenda brown‑sugar on each mound. Finally she places the filled tin in the refrigerator to chill for about an hour, completing the preparation of the mini apple pies.

action.detailed: Spray the muffin tin, spoon the batter into each cup, flatten the tops, sprinkle quick oats and Splenda brown‑sugar, and chill the tin in the refrigerator.
action.actor: Kara Corey, a woman in a white T‑shirt standing at a kitchen counter

nodes.plm_action: Let them cool completely in their molds.
nodes.plm_caption:
The video shows a girl demonstrating how to make muffins. She first presents her muffin pans in the beginning and then proceeds to present and present the finished muffin to the camera, while showing an ingredient on the counter next to her.
The girl wears a gold necklace, a white short-sleeve top, a silver bracelet on her right wrist and a watch on her left wrist. The interior of the kitchen shows two kitchen appliances on the counter to the left of the girl and two kitchen cabinets behind her. The kitchen also has a window on the left side. A picture of the back of a girl wearing black shorts is shown in the middle of the video. Then a picture of a girl wearing a green bikini top is displayed. A muffin pan is in the beginning, filled with muffin batter on it. The finished muffin is displayed on a plate with red, white and green strawberries behind it. The girl's fingers on her right hand are gold with a shiny, metallic finish. The girl has long brown hair with some blonde highlights on the right side. She stands next to a wooden fence.

summary.brief: The presenter shows the chilled mini apple pies and a protein‑powder bottle, then switches to a short workout clip.
summary.detailed: At the start of the segment the woman in a white short‑sleeve top, gold necklace, silver bracelet on her right wrist and a watch on her left wrist opens the fridge and removes a white plate holding several light‑brown mini apple pies that were chilled for an hour. She places the plate on the counter, points to the muffins in the silicone muffin pan, and then lifts a large black protein‑powder container with a red "M" label, rotating it so the label faces the camera while giving two thumbs‑up gestures. She sets the container down, continues speaking while gesturing, and briefly mentions upcoming videos. The scene then cuts to a fitness montage: a woman wearing a neon‑green halter top and blue jeans stands beside a rustic wall with a mirror and a TV screen, performs two sets of jumping jacks, a set of push‑ups and a set of squats, while on‑screen text and social‑media handles advertising her "Physique Update BF%" brand appear.

action.detailed: Lift the plate of chilled mini apple pies, show the muffin pan, rotate the protein‑powder bottle to display its label, give thumbs‑up gestures, then move aside and continue speaking before the video cuts to a short workout where you perform jumping jacks, push‑ups and squats in a green top and jeans.
action.actor: the presenter, a woman wearing a white short‑sleeve top, gold necklace, silver bracelet on her right wrist and a watch on her left wrist

nodes.plm_caption: A woman is making muffins. There are 6 muffin cups. The top of the image is cut off. All objects and hands are visible. The muffins are light brown with visible chunks of dough. They are in their muffin cups. The cups have been sprayed, and then sprinkled with a white powder.

summary.brief: A woman mixes a batter, sprays a muffin tin, fills six cups, and tops each with a pinch of salt and a light dusting of quick oats (white flakes).
summary.detailed: The presenter first adds a series of dry ingredients—powdered sugar, cream cheese, flour, baking soda, baking powder, cinnamon, pumpkin spice—and then folds in wet components such as applesauce, diced apples, lemon juice, sugar‑free maple syrup and nut butter. She stirs the mixture in a clear glass bowl on a red surface until a uniform light‑brown batter with visible apple chunks forms. Next, she sprays a metal muffin tin with cooking‑spray, then uses a metal scoop to portion the batter evenly into each of the six muffin cups. After the batter is in the cups, she sprinkles a pinch of sea salt and a light dusting of quick oats (or white flakes) over each mound before the pan is set aside for the next step.

action.detailed: Spray the muffin tin with cooking spray, spoon the batter into each of the six cups, then sprinkle a pinch of sea salt and a light dusting of quick oats (white flakes) over each cup.
action.actor: the female presenter

The woman is speaking. She has her hand pointing to a red cap. She is gesturing as she speaks.

summary.brief: She takes out the chilled mini apple pies, comments on their texture and flavor, and then showcases the apple‑pie‑flavored protein powder bottle.
summary.detailed: After letting the mini apple pies chill for about an hour, the host removes several from the refrigerator and places them on a white plate, noting that they are a little sticky but still taste delicious with cinnamon, apple and extra protein. She suggests that a longer chill or a quick freeze would make them firmer. She then lifts a large bottle of apple‑pie‑scented protein powder, points to its red cap, gestures with her hands, gives a thumbs‑up, and continues talking about the product while shifting slightly to the side of the frame.

action.detailed: Take the chilled mini apple pies from the fridge, place several on a plate, hold the plate up while describing them, then lift the apple‑pie‑flavored protein powder bottle, point to its red cap, and give a thumbs‑up as you continue speaking.

This video features a short clip of a woman dressed in a gym top and short shorts in a home gym with an armoire door behind her.  She has her back to the camera and turns right to grab some objects.  The video has her image inset into a rustic brown frame on a rustic brown fence. On the right of the screen is an image of the woman in blue jeans with a light green bikini top with her hands on her hips.  There is a title "Physique Update BF%" above the inset picture and the girl's social media icons and website email address listed below it.
This video is very poorly lit and the camera is too far away, so it cannot be determined what items the woman is holding in her hands, nor what the contents of the armoire door are.  Also, the girl's entire body is not fully in the frame.

summary.brief: The influencer appears in rapid cuts, performs brief exercise moves, and is shown in static promotional graphics with mirrored images and text overlays.
summary.detailed: The clip opens with the woman standing against a rustic wall in a green sports bra and blue jeans. She begins a short routine that includes arm stretches, leg swings and a backbend. The video then shifts to a series of static promotional frames that display the same woman in different outfits, mirrored reflections, and overlaid text such as “Physique Update BF%” with social‑media handles. After the graphics, a brief workout sequence is shown: two sets of jumping jacks, one set of push‑ups and one set of squats. The segment ends with another static frame where the woman slightly moves her right arm and leg while a voice‑over introduces the next workout video.

The video starts off with a dark title screen and ends with a bright title screen. There is no sound. Black bars go over the top and bottom of the screen throughout the video.
The video opens with a darkened screen and the title "Kara Corey Fit Life Training" appears in the center of the screen, two diagonal lines cross over it. Then the screen brightens up, but the words "Kara Corey Fit Life Training" remain on the screen.  The video then shows a series of static shots of a girl working out. The first static shot is of a girl in a pink bikini standing with her back turned and resting her arms against a glass block wall. The next shot is of a girl in a lemon green workout top standing with her back turned and resting her arm against a large barn door. The next four shots are static of different girls working out inside the gym, doing tricep dips, shoulder curls, shoulder presses, and standing on a stool and holding a weight. The video then cuts to shots of a girl working out outside while standing on a trailer. The video cuts back to the gym with shots of girls doing the exercises above and moving around. The video ends with the title screen, except for the beginning and last title screen, the rest of the video is solid black except for the gym and outside shots. The bright titles are white.

summary.brief: A dark title screen appears, then a rapid montage of women in colorful workout gear performing various strength moves, followed by animated logo graphics and a quick kitchen glimpse.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with a dark title card that reads “Kara Corey Fit Life Training” with two diagonal lines crossing the text; the screen then brightens while the title remains visible. A fast‑cut collage follows: a woman in a pink bikini stands with her back to a glass block wall, another in a lemon‑green top leans against a large barn door, and four separate gym clips show different women doing tricep dips, shoulder curls, shoulder presses, and holding a weight while standing on a stool. At about eight seconds the view switches to an animated logo for “Kara Corey Fit Life Training” on a black background with moving colored lines, snow‑flake and “Glow” graphics, and brief white text. The final second ends with a blurred kitchen scene showing a woman near a coffee maker, water bottles, bananas and other countertop items, before the segment fades back to the bright title screen.

action.detailed: Women execute a series of strength movements—tricep dips, shoulder curls, shoulder presses, and holding a weight while standing on a stool—in quick static shots against backdrops such as a glass wall, a barn door, gym interiors, and an outdoor trailer.

They move around, pour more, and the video ends with a red measuring spoon moving the contents around. The transparent bowl then fills with ingredients as shown in the video.
All the contents move in slow motion.

summary.brief: A woman adds dry powders, then wet ingredients, and stirs them into a batter in a clear bowl.
summary.detailed: The segment begins with a close‑up of a hand holding a white measuring spoon that pours a white powder into a clear glass bowl set on a red countertop. Additional dry components—flour, baking powder, sugar, an egg (or egg‑like mixture), cinnamon, salt and a pinch of pumpkin spice or baking soda—are added one by one using red and orange spoons while a small email overlay appears in the corner. The bowl now contains a mixture of white and brown powders. Next, the woman adds wet items: a paste, softened butter, lemon juice, apple juice, peanut butter and a splash of maple‑type syrup or vanilla extract, each poured from small cups or spoons into the same bowl. Finally, she moves a silver spoon (and occasionally a red measuring spoon) around the bowl in clockwise, counter‑clockwise and up‑and‑down motions, blending the dry and wet ingredients into a uniform thick batter that shows visible apple pieces and a blend of brown and white particles. The background stays a bright red surface throughout and the lighting remains even.

action.detailed: Add the dry powders to the clear bowl, then pour the wet ingredients, and stir with a spoon in circular motions until the mixture is fully combined.
action.actor: a woman (hands visible)
